header.title: Test runs
header.description: Validate the current Skill for “{{name}}” or compare two immutable versions with the same Evals, preserving logs, evidence, Artifacts, runtime environment, and comparability fingerprints.

list.title: Run history
list.emptyDescription: Save an Evals revision first. You can freeze the current working copy for a Skill effect test, or compare versions once at least two READY versions exist.

start.title: Configure test run
start.description: Choose a Skill effect test or version comparison, then explicitly confirm the immutable subjects and saved Evals revision.
start.skillEffectModeDescription: Keep the existing flow: freeze the current working copy and compare the Skill-enabled target with a No-Skill baseline.
start.versionComparisonModeDescription: Run two immutable versions as paired serial cases with the same Evals to inspect improvements and regressions.
start.versionLoadError: Versions could not be loaded, so comparison is temporarily unavailable.
start.notEnoughVersions: At least two saved versions with READY Snapshots are required.
start.noDraft: No testable working copy is available
start.freezeOnStart: Automatically frozen as an immutable test Snapshot at launch
start.skillEffectSummaryDescription: Both sides run sequentially with the same task and inputs, then separate no-tool graders evaluate them without declaring a winner.
start.versionComparisonSummaryDescription: Both versions run consecutively for each Eval, alternating whether Baseline or Candidate runs first to reduce fixed-order bias.
start.confirmSkillEffect: I confirm the current working copy and EVALS R{{revision}} ({{count}} cases) for this Skill effect test.
start.confirmVersionComparison: I confirm {{candidate}}, {{baseline}}, and EVALS R{{revision}} ({{count}} cases) for this version comparison.
start.confirmPlaceholder: Choose an Evals revision before confirming and starting.
start.activeRunBlocked: This workbench already has an active test run. Wait for it to finish or cancel it first.

detail.notComparableDescription: At least one side has an execution failure or an ungraded assertion. The pass rate only reflects graded assertions; inspect the failure and raw evidence first.
detail.noCase: No execution record exists for this side yet.
detail.executionFailureRunContinues: This execution unit failed while the test run continues with the remaining units.
detail.skillScorePending: The Skill scoring Agent starts after every case is complete.
detail.skillScoreRunning: The Skill scoring Agent is collecting the execution and assertion responses.
detail.skillScoreFailed: The Skill scoring Agent could not produce a report.
detail.legacyEnvironment: No environment Snapshot was stored for this legacy run.
